  • Excel Integration

    Seamlessly integrate with Excel spreadsheets for automated data entry. Generate templates and fill forms row by row with your data.

  • Multi-Form Support

    Use data from a single Excel sheet across multiple forms. Perfect for bulk data entry and form automation workflows.

  • JavaScript Execution

    Execute custom JavaScript code and leverage predefined functions for advanced automation and data manipulation.

  • Smart File Upload

    Automatic file uploading with support for Google Forms, Microsoft Forms, and custom file handling with intelligent naming.

  • Data Scraping

    Extract text, tables, and structured data from websites with powerful scraping capabilities and data processing tools.

  • Browser Automation

    Control browser tabs, windows, and interactions. Handle dialogs, manage downloads, and automate complex web workflows.

  • Date & Time Processing

    Advanced date manipulation, format conversion, and time-based automation for scheduling and data processing.

  • System Integration

    Interact with external applications, perform system-level operations, and integrate with desktop software.

  • PDF Generation

    Automatically generate and save PDFs from web content with customizable formatting and layout options.

  • Math Operations

    Perform calculations, data analysis, and mathematical operations on extracted data with built-in math functions.

  • String Manipulation

    Advanced text processing, regex operations, case conversion, and string manipulation for data cleaning and formatting.

  • Material Design Support

    Full support for Material Design frameworks including Vuetify, MUI, React Material, and Angular Material.
